definitions.gloss: shifting blame; passing responsibility onto others
definitions.explanation: Transferring one's own fault, responsibility, or burden to someone else who should not bear it.
Shifting a financial burden such as increased costs or taxes to another party, such as consumers or suppliers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転嫁|てんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To shift the blame onto others.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転嫁|てんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{卑怯|ひきょう}→卑怯：04345_hikyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Shifting your own failure onto a subordinate is cowardly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転嫁|てんか}⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}きたくない→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to work with someone who tries to pass the blame onto others every time a problem arises.

examples.japanese: ⟦コスト→コスト：06666_kosuto⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転嫁|てんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To pass the cost increase on to consumers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}がり→値上がり：11538_neagari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転嫁|てんか}⟦せざる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: We have no choice but to pass the rise in raw material costs onto our prices.

examples.japanese: {増税分|ぞうぜいぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転嫁|てんか}⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{中小企業|ちゅうしょうきぎょう}→中小企業：24117_chuushoukigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many small and medium enterprises are unable to pass the tax increase onto product prices.

notes:
Compound of {転|てん} (transfer) + {嫁|か} (to marry off, to shift to). Originally meant remarriage of a woman, but this usage is archaic. Modern usage focuses on shifting blame or costs.

Not to be confused with the homophones ⟦{天下|てんか}→天下：12188_tenka⟧ (the whole world; rule) or ⟦{添加|てんか}→添加：13353_tenka⟧ (addition of an ingredient).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転嫁|てんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (shift blame)
- ⟦コスト→コスト：06666_kosuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転嫁|てんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (pass on costs)
- ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転嫁|てんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (pass onto the price)
- ⟦{責任転嫁|せきにんてんか}→責任転嫁：17052_sekinintenka⟧ (blame-shifting, used as a compound noun)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- なすりつける: to pin (blame) on someone (more colloquial, negative)
- {押|お}しつける: to force onto someone (broader usage, not limited to blame)
